titleEs: Maxroll Last Epoch vs Last Epoch Tools — el duelo de los hubs
titleEn: Maxroll Last Epoch vs Last Epoch Tools — the hubs showdown
descriptionEs: Los dos hubs dominantes de Last Epoch. Maxroll prioriza depth editorial con guides extensos y planner integrated; Last Epoch Tools prioriza breadth comunitaria con DB exhaustiva, loot filter sharing y character profiles.
descriptionEn: Last Epoch's two dominant hubs. Maxroll prioritizes editorial depth with long guides and integrated planner; Last Epoch Tools prioritizes community breadth with exhaustive DB, loot filter sharing, and character profiles.
verdictEs: Maxroll si quieres entender por qué cada slot de tu build importa y leer guides largas con justificación. Last Epoch Tools si quieres scan rápido del meta, lookup de item específico, sharear filter o ver character profile de otro jugador. La mayoría usa los dos en flujos distintos — Maxroll para deep dive, LE Tools para todo lo demás.
verdictEn: Maxroll if you want to understand why every build slot matters and read long justified guides. Last Epoch Tools if you want a fast meta scan, specific item lookup, share a filter, or view another player's character profile. Most use both in different flows — Maxroll for deep dive, LE Tools for everything else.

useCases.labelEs: Deep dive de build con justification per slot
useCases.labelEn: Deep build dive with per-slot justification
useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll publica guides editorial-curated con prose long-form explicando cada skill, blessing y aspect choice. LE Tools tiene builds auto-crawleados de YouTube — quality variable, sin justification depth comparable.
useCases.reasonEn: Maxroll publishes editorial-curated guides with long-form prose explaining each skill, blessing, and aspect choice. LE Tools has YouTube auto-crawled builds — variable quality, no comparable justification depth.

useCases.labelEs: Lookup específico de item o affix
useCases.reasonEs: LE Tools tiene database exhaustiva navegable: filters por tier, clase, tipo. Maxroll embeds item info en guides pero no tiene browseable DB equivalente.
useCases.reasonEn: LE Tools has an exhaustive browseable database: filters by tier, class, type. Maxroll embeds item info in guides but doesn't have an equivalent browseable DB.

useCases.labelEs: Crear y compartir loot filter custom
useCases.labelEn: Create and share a custom loot filter
useCases.reasonEs: LE Tools tiene editor visual integrado con community sharing built-in. Maxroll publica filters como download files sin editor — workflow inferior para custom work.
useCases.reasonEn: LE Tools has an integrated visual editor with built-in community sharing. Maxroll publishes filters as download files without an editor — inferior workflow for custom work.

useCases.labelEs: Patch reaction y tier list update post-balance
useCases.labelEn: Patch reaction and tier list update post-balance
useCases.reasonEs: Maxroll team actualiza tier lists y revisa guides dentro de 24-48h post-patch con editorial analysis. LE Tools depende de community submissions; meta consensus toma más tiempo en consolidarse.
useCases.reasonEn: The Maxroll team updates tier lists and revises guides within 24-48h post-patch with editorial analysis. LE Tools depends on community submissions; meta consensus takes longer to consolidate.

useCases.labelEn: Show your character to friends or community
